text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Epiglottic entrapment is a type of illness that affects an Umamusume's respiratory tract. Due to the abnormal folds in my throat, I have difficulty breathing when running longer distances…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I guess I'll just have to take the 2,000-meter Shuka Sho off my schedule. Good luck out there, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I get surgery, I'll have to take a hiatus of at least six months… So I'd rather not get it if I can help it. If I stop running for that long, people will give up on their dreams, and I'll be too late to help them!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's time to change directions! My next goal is the 1,600-meter Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A few days after deciding that, I get a message from Taiki saying she's going to be running in the Mile Championship too! This won't be an easy one…
